run_scenario_with_agent: run a ScenarioRunner with a config and scenario to execute an agent in a simulated environment
run_scenario_without_agent: run a ScenarioRunner with agent set to None to validate a scenario without any agent
judge_completed_events: run a ScenarioRunner in judge_only mode to validate a scenario from a list of completed events
apply_a2a_config: apply agent-to-agent augmentation to a proportion of apps in a scenario using _apply_a2a_config
export_scenario_trace: export a scenario trace to JSON via _export_trace after running a scenario with ScenarioRunner
